law: GAME DONOR != GAME SKIN. Transfer only an abstract mechanism into an existing owner; name non-transfer residue; prove the transfer in the current host.

donors.observed_mechanic: A changing solar-system mystery repeats through a time loop; progress is driven by discovered answers and relationships among clues rather than a conventional task ladder.
donors.transferable_rule: UNKNOWN != TASK. Attach a question/gap to the addressed object; let new knowledge change what is reachable without manufacturing obligation.
donors.implementation: Already transferred: MORE HERE derives only from route.evolution.question, route.open_gaps, or unresolved declared exits and renders on the held object after CATCH contraction.

donors.observed_mechanic: Each escape attempt varies while persistent growth and story discovery continue across attempts.
donors.transferable_rule: ATTEMPT END != CONTINUITY RESET. A failed, aborted, or completed run may leave one durable addressed residue without becoming a backlog.
donors.implementation: Candidate: execution hosts emit one source-addressed residue/witness on failed or aborted attempts; FIELD reducer keeps it RESIDUE unless CURRENT or explicit selection promotes a next move.
donors.proof_needed: Synthetic failed/aborted run proves one residue survives while no NOW/NEXT authority is minted.

donors.observed_mechanic: Asynchronous social play lets useful player-built structures/resources appear in other players' worlds; later entries also expose travelled routes and shared infrastructure.
donors.transferable_rule: REPEATED PASSAGE MAY EARN INFRASTRUCTURE. Helpful traces can accumulate asynchronously before anyone coordinates synchronously.
donors.implementation: Candidate: derive read-only edge wear from repeated exact handoff/RETURN pairs; after >=3 independent traversals of the same host-to-host edge, surface an adapter candidate under CONFLUENCE/PORTS. Never auto-promote or infer priority.
donors.proof_needed: Replay fixture produces deterministic edge counts and candidate threshold without creating route/queue/state authority.

donors.observed_mechanic: Enemy attacks are telegraphed before the turn resolves, so the player can inspect consequences and choose a counter before commitment.
donors.transferable_rule: FORECAST BEFORE COMMIT. Before a lawful move, expose effect class, authority/commit boundary, target, and reversibility status without executing it.
donors.field_host: INTERPHASE action surface + FIELD held action aperture
donors.implementation: This transfer: actionSurface() emits deterministic forecasts from move authority; FIELD NEXT shows the first forecast and updates it on focus/hover without adding mutation authority.
donors.proof_needed: Carrier self-test + FIELD aperture self-test + browser smoke show forecast changes with move focus and no action fires.

donors.observed_mechanic: Progress comes from scanning, cutting, dismantling, and salvaging hazardous ships while respecting dependencies and dangerous components.
donors.transferable_rule: SUBTRACTION REQUIRES A SALVAGE MAP. Before deletion, identify what survives, what can be cut, what depends on it, and what can become dangerous when separated.
donors.implementation: Candidate: destructive route/branch retirement packet requires KEEP / CUT / DEPENDENTS / HAZARDS / RETURN. Refuse 'delete as cleanup' when a dependent or unrecovered donor remains.
donors.proof_needed: Fixture with one safe retirement and one hazardous dependency; audit must allow first and block second.

donors.observed_mechanic: Restoration concludes by cleaning up the machinery used to restore the environment, leaving the recovered system rather than permanent builder infrastructure.
donors.transferable_rule: THE SCAFFOLD SHOULD DISAPPEAR WHEN THE CAPABILITY SURVIVES WITHOUT IT.
donors.implementation: Candidate: temporary probes/helpers may declare retire_when + surviving_owner; audit flags scaffolds whose function is already absorbed by a host so the default next move is delete/fold/alias, not preserve chrome.
donors.proof_needed: Synthetic manifest fixture marks one absorbed scaffold as retirement-ready while preserving a still-needed proof fixture.

stop: Do not implement the remaining candidates merely because they are attractive. Each must remove a named FIELD friction and inherit an existing host's authority/RETURN.
